description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

FishEye Software, Inc. is hiring a Junior Front-End Software Developer to develop and maintain the Operational Dashboard (OPDASH) for Missile Defense Agency test events. The role involves gathering customer requirements, building and enhancing software features, and conducting unit testing.
Junior Front-End Software Developer builds Angular apps, C# .NET APIs, and SQL Server databases for missile-defense testing

Responsibilities:
• Review, analyze, and modify OPDASH in support of Missile Defense Agency test events
• Consult with customers to identify issues and potential improvements
• Develop C# .NET Web API application and work with Entity framework
• Develop and improve a single page app in Angular 20
• Develop a SQL Server database and make design modifications as needed
• Ensure consistent level of quality in the design and implementation of software solutions

Requirements:
• Must be a U.S. citizen and eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) Secret Security Clearance
• BS in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
• 1+ years experience working with Software Design and Development
• Familiarity with Angular17 or newer
• Familiarity with C# .NET Core WebAPI and entity framework
• Ability to design and build an intuitive User Interface (UI)
• Knowledge of Windows networking and Windows Web Server management (IIS), and willingness to assist with debugging cyber security issues

Preferred:
• Familiarity with front end data store tools like Akita
• Familiarity working on a highly networked application
• Familiarity debugging problems in IIS
• Understanding of and experience with secure programming techniques
• Ability to troubleshoot the current Windows Operating System (Win 11 Enterprise - 23H2)
• Ability to troubleshoot the Web Server (Internet Information Systems v8.1)
• Experience with the React framework
• Have a CompTia A+, Net+, or Sec+, or have the willingness/ability to obtain one
